scope: Local range-planning measurement; not full sysbench or TPC-C acceptance
change: Skip table-path derivation when available paths exclude it
machine: Apple M4 Max, 128 GiB RAM, Darwin 24.6.0
cluster: One local PD, TiKV, Go TiDB; v9.0.0-beta.2.pre-nightly
reproduce: python3 rust/scripts/compare-sysbench.py --server before:53000 --server after:53001 --server go:45000 --database perf_sysbench --workload select_random_ranges --threads 2 --seconds 30 --rounds 3 --table-size 100000
